subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: Should OpenClaw expose one additive public plugin-hook trace and correlation contract across agent, message, and subagent hooks, and which field names and availability guarantees should it standardize?
rationale: Current main has several partial correlation fields, but unifying message ids, run ids, span hierarchy, and requester/child relationships is a public plugin SDK decision rather than a narrow bug patch.

options.title: Standardize a unified additive contract
options.body: Approve a single documented correlation shape shared across relevant hook contexts and events, with optional fields where a runtime cannot know the value.

options.title: Land narrower approved slices
options.body: Keep this umbrella open while separate issues such as outbound message verification and typed agent_start define smaller API additions independently.

options.title: Defer to diagnostics-only tracing
options.body: Treat the diagnostic trace carrier and existing lifecycle runId fields as sufficient and close or supersede plugin-hook-specific correlation requests.

recommendation.title: Standardize a unified additive contract
recommendation.body: Approve a single documented correlation shape shared across relevant hook contexts and events, with optional fields where a runtime cannot know the value.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest merged trace and hook-contract changes and are best positioned to judge a coherent follow-up contract shape before broader owner review.
